html:
SMTO-EXE-0073 — The clipboard content is too large for SMTO

GUID: de930509-7931-55c0-bf45-b43b14365c33
Slug: clipboard-size-limit
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: clipboard

What happened

  • The text, list of files or image was bigger than SMTO can copy or paste through the Gateway computer's clipboard, so SMTO stopped that step.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. For text, copy less than 65,536 characters at a time, about 30 pages of plain text. SMTO refuses clipboard text above that size.
  2. For files, copy no more than 128 files at once; for images, use one under 16 MB and under 16 million pixels, about 4000 by 4000. The Gateway's clipboard limits how many files and how big an image SMTO will handle in one step.
  3. For anything bigger, save it as a file on the Gateway computer and ask SMTO to use that file instead of the clipboard. Saved files aren't limited by these clipboard sizes.

What success looks like

  • SMTO completes the copy or paste and reports how much it handled.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the Gateway, saying roughly how large the content was. Don't include the private content itself.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Clipboard validation or retrieval exceeded a hard limit: text over 65,536 characters or 256 KiB, more than 128 files or 128 KiB of paths (4 KiB per path), an image over 16 MiB or 16 million pixels, a response over 2 MiB, or an empty file list.

What this means

  • Clipboard validation or native retrieval exceeded text, file-count/path-byte, image-byte/pixel or response-envelope bounds; an empty file list also fails its accepted list contract. These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.

Why this can happen

  • Clipboard validation or native retrieval exceeded text, file-count/path-byte, image-byte/pixel or response-envelope bounds; an empty file list also fails its accepted list contract.

How to diagnose it

  • Identify the exact text, path, image or envelope bound from the request and retained result; do not silently truncate content.

How to fix it

  • Use at most 65536 text characters/256 KiB, 128 files/128 KiB paths (4096 bytes per path, at least one path), or a 16 MiB/16 million pixel image, as defined in src/gateway_core/clipboard_contract.py. Move larger content as a file on the Gateway instead of through the clipboard.
  • Use at most 65536 text characters/256 KiB, 128 files/128 KiB paths, or a 16 MiB/16 million pixel image.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use at most 65536 text characters/256 KiB, 128 files/128 KiB paths, or a 16 MiB/16 million pixel image.

How to verify the fix

  • The complete intended bounded payload passes validation, or a different supported transfer method handles larger content.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay an uncertain clipboard write or include content in diagnostics.

Technical notes

  • These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
